Title: Vestil DHHT‑500S Dual‑Handle Steel Hand Truck  
Category: Industrial Hand Trucks  
Brand: Vestil  
Description: A 500‑lb capacity steel hand truck featuring dual handles for superior control.  
Details: Equipped with 10‑inch pneumatic wheels, a 44‑½” height, 22‑½” width, 17‑½” depth, and a 13‑¾”×6‑½” nose plate.

Title: iPhone 12 Pro Max Silicone Gel Case – Midnight Blue  
Category: Mobile Accessories  
Brand: XSHNUO  
Description: A slim liquid silicone case with a microfiber inner lining that protects your iPhone 12 Pro Max and its camera.  
Details: Precise cutouts, 1.5 mm camera lip, wireless‑charging compatible, easy to clean, anti‑slip finish.

Title: 20W USB‑C PD Fast Charger Set  
Category: Electronics  
Brand: GRNLFFF  
Description: A compact 2‑pack of 20W USB‑C power delivery chargers with included 3.3‑ft USB‑C to Lightning cables for rapid, safe charging of iPhone, iPad, and compatible Apple devices.  
Details: Features 20W PD output, multi‑protection circuitry, international voltage compatibility, and a tangle‑free cable length ideal for home, office, or travel use.

Title: Lion Brand Wool Ease Thick & Quick Yarn Pack  
Category: Yarn & Fiber  
Brand: Lion Brand Yarn  
Description: A 3‑pack of thick, super‑bulky wool‑blend yarn, ideal for warm sweaters, jackets, and beginners.  
Details: 80% acrylic, 20% wool; machine washable, 6oz/141g per skein, gauge 9 st × 12 r on US 13 needles.

Title: Ploveyy USB‑C External CD/DVD Superdrive  
Category: Electronics  
Brand: Ploveyy  
Description: A slim, lightweight USB‑C powered external optical drive that reads and writes CD‑R, DVD‑R, and DVD‑RW discs on Mac and Windows PCs.  
Details: Plug‑and‑play with no power cable required, supports USB‑3.0 transfer speeds, includes a USB‑C to USB‑A adapter, and features shock‑resistant design for travel.

Title: Texas Recreation Ultimate Swimming Foam Pool Floating Mattress  
Category: Swimming Accessories  
Brand: Texas Recreation  
Description: A thick, vinyl‑coated foam mattress that floats luxuriously in any pool.  
Details: Features 2.25″ closed‑cell foam, head‑support pillow, and easy‑clean vinyl for sun, chlorine, and salt water resistance.

Title: Portable Overhead Phone Mount with Built‑In Ring Light  
Category: Electronics  
Brand: yAyusi  
Description: A compact, wireless ring light and phone holder that rotates 360°, perfect for recording and makeup tutorials.  
Details: Features a 1800 mAh battery for up to 12 hours, adjustable brightness and color temperature, and a foldable tripod design for versatile mounting.

Title: Interlocking Rubber Anti‑Slip Floor Mat Pack  
Category: Home & Garden  
Brand: Wizgree  
Description: A pack of 12 flexible PVC interlocking mats that snap together to create a non‑slip, anti‑fatigue floor surface for kitchens, pools, patios, and balconies.  
Details: Each 11.8" × 11.8" mat is 17 mm thick, grease‑ and water‑resistant, and easy to clean for both indoor and outdoor use.

Title: 30mm 24V Dual Ball Bearing Blower Fan  
Category: Electronics  
Brand: WINSINN  
Description: A lightweight, 30mm micro blower fan powered by 24V, ideal for tight spaces such as 3D printers, Raspberry Pi, and small PC cases.  
Details: Features dual ball bearings, 5‑year warranty, 1.55 CFM airflow, 22.5 dBA noise, 7000 RPM, and a 2‑pin connector with 300 mm lead.

Title: 1" PEXworx Oxygen‑Barrier Radiant Heat PEX Tubing – 300 ft  
Category: Plumbing  
Brand: PEXworx  
Description: 1‑inch PEX tubing engineered for radiant heat and other heating systems.  
Details: Features an oxygen‑barrier, SDR‑9 wall, 80 psi pressure rating, and compatibility with push‑fit, crimp, and compression fittings.

Title: Dell Inspiron 5490 24‑Inch All‑In‑One  
Category: Computers  
Brand: Dell  
Description: A 24‑inch all‑in‑one desktop featuring a full‑HD display, Intel Core i5 processor, and 512 GB SSD.  
Details: It includes 8 GB DDR4 RAM, Wi‑Fi, and Windows 10 Home for a smooth multitasking experience.

Title: Quick Attach Cylinder for Bobcat Skid Steer  
Category: Industrial Machinery Parts  
Brand: Aftermarket  
Description: A reliable hydraulic quick attach cylinder that fits Bobcat skid steers T180 through T320.  
Details: Features a 1.75" rod, 1.0" bore, and 6.82" stroke, replacing OEM part 6805158.

Title: Grey Tinted Clear Acrylic Plexiglas Sheet  
Category: Materials  
Brand: plexiglas  
Description: A 24" x 24" x 1/8" grey-tinted acrylic sheet with protective removable masking.  
Details: Features a nominal thickness of 1/8", saw-cut edges, and a ±1/8" dimensional tolerance.

Title: 8x8ft Christmas Barn Wood Door Photography Backdrop  
Category: Photography  
Brand: CYLYH  
Description: A large 8x8ft vinyl backdrop featuring a festive barn door, Christmas tree, snow, and holiday décor for family photo shoots.  
Details: Lightweight, high‑resolution print, wrinkle‑free design, and easy to set up on walls or frames.

Title: Dell Inspiron 14 7000 2‑in‑1 Touch Laptop  
Category: Electronics  
Brand: Dell  
Description: A slim 14” business laptop with a full‑HD touchscreen, AMD Ryzen 5 4500U, 16 GB RAM, 1 TB SSD, and Windows 10.  
Details: Features a backlit keyboard, fingerprint reader, Wi‑Fi 6, and Thunderbolt 3/USB 3.2 ports for versatile connectivity.

Title: Spigen Crystal Glitter TPU Case  
Category: Electronics  
Brand: Spigen  
Description: A lightweight, glitter‑infused TPU case that protects and enhances your Galaxy S22 Ultra.  
Details: Features clear flexible TPU, reinforced buttons for quick responsiveness, and easy installation/removal.

Title: Artki Replacement Projector Lamp with Housing  
Category: Electronics  
Brand: Artki  
Description: A brand‑new projector lamp with housing designed for EIKI LC projectors.  
Details: Comes with 200‑day warranty, 30‑day money‑back guarantee, and lifetime customer support.

Title: Cicatricell Advanced Scar Care Cream  
Category: Skincare  
Brand: Kenda Aesthetics  
Description: A clinically tested cream that blends botanical extracts, essential oils, and advanced fatty acids to improve scar appearance and texture.  
Details: Enriched with argan oil, tea tree oil, shea butter, peptides, and vitamins A, E, C, K for rapid redness reduction, moisturization, and enhanced skin regeneration.

Title: Musical Light‑Up Reindeer Plush  
Category: Toys & Games  
Brand: Houwsbaby  
Description: A 13″ plush reindeer that sings eight Christmas tunes and glows in the dark.  
Details: Features a music button for rotating holiday songs, a separate light button for colorful glow, and is safe for children 3+ with AAA battery power.

Title: 925 Silver Moments O Charm Carrier Pendant  
Category: Jewelry  
Brand: Bolenvi  
Description: A sterling silver O-shaped pendant that opens to hold up to three charms, dangles, or pendants.  
Details: Features a small button that clicks closed, dimensions 32.5 mm × 25 mm × 2.8 mm, and is compatible with various European bead charms.

Title: Nakleo 5‑Pack Reusable Airplane Stencils  
Category: Craft Supplies  
Brand: Nakleo  
Description: A set of five translucent plastic stencils featuring airplane patterns, perfect for decorating kids’ rooms and creative projects.  
Details: Each stencil is reusable, washable, and safe for use on walls, paper, or fabric, providing a fun, cost‑effective alternative to wallpaper.

Title: XYZPrinting Da Vinci Mini Wireless 3D Printer  
Category: Electronics  
Brand: XYZprinting  
Description: A compact, fully open‑source 3D printer with wireless connectivity and upgradable materials.  
Details: Prints 5.9"³ at 200 µm resolution, heats in 1 min, and supports PLA, Carbon PLA, and future metallic filaments.

Title: Samsung Galaxy A10 (Global, 32 GB/2 GB, 6.2″ HD+ Display)  
Category: Mobile Phones  
Brand: Samsung  
Description: 4G LTE unlocked smartphone with a 6.2‑inch HD+ IPS LCD and dual‑camera setup.  
Details: Runs Android 9.0, powered by an Exynos 7884 Octa‑core CPU, 32 GB internal storage expandable via microSD, and includes a 13 MP rear camera and a 5 MP front camera with LED flash.

Title: Feisty Pets Ferdinand Flamefart Dragon Plush  
Category: Toys & Games  
Brand: Feisty Pets  
Description: A plush dragon that changes expression from cute to feisty when squeezed, made of polyester and weighing 7.4 ounces.  
Details: Measures 9" x 5.6" x 5.6", is surface washable, and comes with no assembly required.

Title: Tandy Leather Craftool Corner Round Punch  
Category: Crafting Tools  
Brand: Tandy Leather  
Description: A precision punch for cutting clean, uniform 1‑1/8" rounded corners in leather.  
Details: Features a durable black blade, 30‑piece pack, and a compact design for easy storage.

Title: IQShield LIQuidSkin Full Body & Screen Protector  
Category: Electronics Accessories  
Brand: IQShield  
Description: A single clear film that fully covers the Sony Vaio Tap 11 tablet, offering self‑healing, anti‑scratch protection and a bubble‑free, residue‑free installation.  
Details: The ultra‑thin, flexible film includes UV protection to prevent yellowing, True‑Feel sensitivity for responsive touch, and a lifetime replacement warranty.

Title: 150 m OM2 Multimode SC‑SC Duplex Fiber Optic Cable  
Category: Electronics – Networking  
Brand: Ultra Spec Cables  
Description: 150‑meter Orange OM2 multimode fiber optic cable with SC‑SC duplex connectors for high‑speed data transmission.  
Details: Features 50/125 µm core/cladding, 850 nm wavelength, zip‑cord jacket, ideal for LAN, CCTV, and data center applications.

Title: European Leather Works Brown Latigo Leather Straps  
Category: Leather Goods  
Brand: European Leather Works  
Description: Heavy‑grade, 9‑10oz brown latigo straps made from thick, natural cowhide, ideal for holsters, harnesses, and saddles.  
Details: 1.25” wide by 84” long, smooth top grain, suede bottom, pre‑finished oil‑tanned, colorfast, and firm yet flexible for easy cutting, stitching, or punching.

Title: Plantronics DA90 USB Audio Processor  
Category: Electronics  
Brand: Plantronics  
Description: A compact USB audio processor that enhances call quality with advanced noise and echo cancellation for clearer conversations.  
Details: Features automatic gain control, acoustic exposure monitoring, and quick‑disconnect capability for convenient headset management.

Title: Nevada State Reusable Mylar Stencil  
Category: Craft Supplies  
Brand: Stencil Revolution  
Description: A durable, laser‑cut 12 mil Mylar stencil of the Nevada state, perfect for painting projects.  
Details: Made in the USA, the thick mylar lasts for hundreds of uses and is ideal for wall décor, furniture, signs, and apparel.

Title: MyGEKOgear Orbit 530 Dash Cam  
Category: Electronics  
Brand: MyGEKOgear  
Description: 1296p Full HD dash cam with wide‑angle view, night vision, and Wi‑Fi sharing.  
Details: Includes a 16 GB microSD card, G‑sensor, suction mount, and touch LCD display.

Title: 36‑Pack Wooden Square Dowel Rods  
Category: Crafts & Hobbies  
Brand: HZLHZYY  
Description: Unfinished natural wood square dowel rods perfect for miniature modeling and DIY projects.  
Details: Comes in 36 pieces (12 each of ½, ¼, and ⅛‑inch widths) all 12 inches long, ideal for building, painting, and laser‑cut crafts.

Title: BW Elite UV 52mm Multicoated Multithreaded Filter  
Category: Photography Accessories  
Brand: BW Elite  
Description: A clear 52mm UV filter that absorbs ultraviolet light to reduce the bluish cast of daylight.  
Details: Features multi‑coated glass, a rugged black metal filter ring, a slim design to minimize vignetting, and a 2‑year warranty.

Title: Vlifree EMF Detector 5 Hz‑3.5 GHz  
Category: Electronics  
Brand: Vlifree  
Description: A battery‑powered EMF meter with a backlit LCD that measures magnetic, electric fields and temperature.  
Details: It offers high‑resolution 3‑in‑1 readings, audible and visual alarms, data hold/max settings, and is portable for home, office or ghost‑hunting use.

Title: SmartThings Station 15W Wireless Charger  
Category: Home Electronics  
Brand: Samsung  
Description: A compact smart hub that automates routines and offers 15W wireless charging in one sleek package.  
Details: Features a Smart Button for instant home control, Wi‑Fi connectivity, and quick charging with an included adapter.

Title: Marshall Stanmore II Bluetooth Speaker  
Category: Audio & Accessories  
Brand: Marshall  
Description: A powerful 15W stereo speaker with Bluetooth 5.0 that delivers clear, clean sound anywhere you go.  
Details: Features a textured vinyl finish for durability, 80W total output, and tabletop mounting for versatile placement.

Title: United Scientific Brass Delux Slotted Weight Set  
Category: Accessories  
Brand: United Scientific  
Description: A brass slotted weight set with rack for precision calibration.  
Details: Contains 8 metric weights (500g, 200g, 100g, 50g, 20g×2, 10g) and a rack for easy storage.

Title: Accuform ZRS642 SDS Binder  
Category: Office Supplies  
Brand: Accuform  
Description: A 3‑ring safety data sheet binder with a 36‑inch metal security chain.  
Details: Red lettering on yellow cover and spine, 2‑½″ width, plastic construction.

Title: Barbie Limited‑Edition Wedgwood Collection Doll  
Category: Toys & Games  
Brand: Mattel  
Description: A porcelain‑inspired Barbie doll dressed in a pastel pink taffeta gown, complete with embroidered details and a cameo‑choker necklace.  
Details: Comes in a 14 × 13 × 4‑inch package, weighs 0.01 oz, and is suitable for collectors aged 15 and up.

Title: WADORN PU Leather Bag Handles  
Category: Accessories  
Brand: WADORN  
Description: A set of six 21.5‑inch PU leather strap replacements, available in brown, black, and beige, perfect for upgrading handbags and shoulder bags.  
Details: Features pre‑drilled holes and iron rivets for easy DIY installation, with a durable, smooth finish and comfortable grip.

Title: PJ Masks Mini Party Favors Set – 24 Grab n Go Play Packs with Coloring Book, Stickers & Utensils  
Category: Party Supplies  
Brand: PJ Masks Kids  
Description: A bundle of 24 miniature PJ Masks play packs that include a coloring book, stickers, and coloring tools, perfect for birthday parties and goodie bags.  
Details: Each play pack is officially licensed PJ Masks merchandise, compact in size, and ready to be paired with any other PJ Masks party supplies.

Title: 18‑Foot Black CB Base Antenna  
Category: Electronics  
Brand: Tram  
Description: A heavy‑fiber 18‑ft CB antenna that covers 26‑31 MHz with 5.75 dBd gain.  
Details: Features twin tuning rings, omnidirectional radiation, and a stainless‑steel mounting bracket.

Title: LENCENT Bluetooth 5.3 FM Car Adapter with 20W PD & QC3.0 Charger  
Category: Electronics  
Brand: LENCENT  
Description: A full‑metal Bluetooth 5.3 FM transmitter that streams Hi‑Fi music, enables clear calls, and charges devices via 20W PD and QC3.0 fast charging.  
Details: One‑piece zinc‑alloy build, heat‑dissipating, color‑light display, supports dual‑device charging, and compatible with all 12‑24V vehicles.

Title: Bindpo EW-88C Lens Hood for Canon EF 24‑70mm 82mm  
Category: Photography Accessories  
Brand: Bindpo  
Description: A durable, ABS plastic lens hood that shields the Canon EF 24‑70mm 82mm lens from stray light and environmental elements.  
Details: It reduces glare, protects against scratches, fingerprints, wind, sand, rain, and snow while fitting securely on the lens.

Title: HQTelecom Industrial Wall Phone with Dialpad  
Category: Electronics  
Brand: HQTelecom  
Description: Durable wall‑mounted telephone with raised keypad and metal back, built for commercial use.  
Details: Features a 3‑way conference call, handset volume control, and polycarbonate hook switch, compatible with any analog PSTN or VOIP line.

Title: 6‑Pack Friction‑Powered Construction Vehicle Toy Set  
Category: Toys & Games  
Brand: Jellydog  
Description: A set of six small metal construction trucks that move by friction, perfect for imaginative play and safe for children 3 and older.  
Details: Each 3‑inch vehicle (dumper, bulldozer, forklift, tank truck, asphalt car, excavator) features durable ABS plastic and alloy parts, comes in a custom gift box, and requires no batteries.

Title: NSI Rotary On‑Off Switch (SPST)  
Category: Electronics  
Brand: NSI Industries  
Description: A compact 0.6" wide, 0.718" high rotary switch with on‑off circuit function for 3/1 A at 125/250 VAC.  
Details: Features SPST poles and throws with wire‑lead connection and a robust 125/250 VAC voltage rating.

Title: Ender 3 Pro Tempered Glass Build Plate  
Category: 3D Printing Accessories  
Brand: Comgrow  
Description: Upgraded tempered glass plate with composite coating and 4 bed clips for secure, edge‑free prints on Creality Ender 3 series.  
Details: Features a durable 8‑Mohs inorganic coating, easy clip attachment, and tool‑free model removal.

Title: Condold Steel Crypto Wallet Set  
Category: Electronics  
Brand: Condold  
Description: A durable, waterproof steel wallet set for securely storing up to 24-word cryptocurrency seed phrases.  
Details: Includes 36 stamped pieces (0‑9, A‑Z, symbol), uniquely labeled with anti‑tear stickers, and a custom button for easy assembly.

Title: 4.3″ HD Wireless Rear View Monitor Kit  
Category: Electronics  
Brand: Podofo  
Description: A compact 4.3‑inch HD rear‑view monitor with wireless backup camera, 1080p night vision, and 149° field of view.  
Details: Includes dual license‑plate camera mounts, 263‑ft range, waterproof (IP69) design, and automatic reverse‑triggered display with grid lines and 180° adjustable mounting.

Title: Unfinished Wooden Gingerbread Man Christmas Ornaments  
Category: Home & Garden  
Brand: Bright Creations  
Description: A 24‑pack set of unfinished wooden gingerbread man ornaments, ready for painting and personalization.  
Details: Each ornament measures 3.2 × 4.7 inches, 0.1 inches thick, and includes four festive designs for a unique DIY holiday gift.

Title: Domino MotoGP Grip  
Category: Motorcycle Accessories  
Brand: Domino  
Description: High‑performance orange grip designed exclusively for MotoGP racing.  
Details: Dual‑compound construction offers firm inner grip and softer outer layer for progressive feedback, 126 mm length with open ends.

Title: 1000 ml Lab Distillation Apparatus  
Category: Laboratory Equipment  
Brand: WMN_TRULYSTEP  
Description: A complete glassware kit for essential oil and water distillation.  
Details: Includes a 1 L distillation flask, condenser, separatory funnel, and all necessary accessories for easy, precise distillation.

Title: Seidio Dilex Case & Holster Combo with Kickstand for Note 7  
Category: Electronics Accessories  
Brand: Seidio  
Description: Protective dual‑layer case with integrated magnetic kickstand for hands‑free viewing.  
Details: Features Hexguard cushioning, raised edges, 3.6 mm slim design, and precise cutouts for full accessory compatibility.

Title: Genuine Black Suede Leather Sheet  
Category: Crafts & Hobby  
Brand: LeatherAA Italian Leather Company  
Description: High‑quality 12"x18" (30x45 cm) black suede leather sheet for crafting.

Title: Belkin iPod Mini Leather Pouch  
Category: Accessories  
Brand: Belkin  
Description: Stylish blue leather pouch that protects and keeps your iPod mini accessible.  
Details: Features a top-loading design, clear PVC window for the screen, and a lanyard strap for secure wrist wear.

Title: Hillman Group 12 × 2‑Inch Zinc Flat‑Head Wood Screw (20‑Pack)  
Category: Hardware  
Brand: Hillman Group  
Description: 12‑gauge wood screws with a 2‑inch length and zinc coating, perfect for joining two wood surfaces.  
Details: Each screw features a Phillips drive, flat head, coarse thread and a smooth shank for strong, tight fastening.

Title: Ifergoo Polymer Clay Kit – 32 Color Oven‑Bake Modeling Clay with Tools  
Category: Arts & Crafts  
Brand: Ifergoo  
Description: A 32‑pack set of vibrant, non‑toxic polymer clay blocks, each 0.7 oz, perfect for creating custom sculptures and jewelry, accompanied by a complete set of sculpting tools and an instruction booklet.

Title: Burnt Orange Beats Solo HD Headphones Skin  
Category: Accessories  
Brand: WraptorSkinz

Title: DASHAN 7x7ft Round Polyester Backdrop Cloth  
Category: Photography Accessories  
Brand: DASHAN  
Description: A 7‑foot diameter, wrinkle‑resistant polyester backdrop for photo booths, parties, and studio shoots.  
Details: Features high‑resolution digital printing, durable hand‑sewn edges, and easy fold‑and‑carry design.

Title: EZYCOK Kids Backpack – Water‑Resistant 14" Laptop & Lunch Bag  
Category: Accessories  
Brand: EZYCOK  
Description: A lightweight, waterproof backpack with a built‑in lunch bag, designed for elementary school kids.  
Details: Features padded shoulder straps, multiple compartments for a 14" laptop, books, lunch, and small items, plus a durable canvas exterior.

Title: ProTech HDPE Marine Plastic Sheet – 12"x24"x¼" Black  
Category: Construction Materials  
Brand: ProTech Plastic  
Description: Durable, UV‑stable HDPE sheet with one marine‑finished side, ideal for indoor and outdoor projects.

Title: Hoshizaki 3A0172-01 Transformer  
Category: Electronics  
Brand: Hoshizaki  
Description: OEM replacement transformer for Hoshizaki commercial refrigeration units.  
Details: Compact 6"x4"x4" unit weighing 0.9 lb, certified for reliable operation and safety.

Title: BoxWave ClearTouch Anti‑Glare Screen Protectors (2‑Pack)  
Category: Electronics Accessories  
Brand: BoxWave  
Description: Dual‑layer ClearTouch film protects BOSS Audio screens from glare, fingerprints, dust, and scratches while maintaining crystal‑clear visibility.  
Details: Precision‑cut, low‑tack adhesive, UV‑blocking, reusable with warm water, and comes with an applicator card and microfiber cloth.

Title: Jumanji Board Game Collector Replica  
Category: Board Games  
Brand: The Noble Collection  
Description: An officially licensed, full‑size prop replica that also functions as a complete Jumanji board game for 2‑4 players.  
Details: Comes with a board, four tokens, two dice, instruction manual, and a 1 A battery, measuring 16 × 11 × 4 in and weighing 1.91 lb.

Title: Casino Chip Display Board – 12"x16" Velvet Insert  
Category: Home & Garden  
Brand: Spinettis  
Description: A single-piece black velvet board that securely holds 35 standard 39mm casino chips.

Title: Kokubo Adhesive Toasty Hands – 10 Pack  
Category: Personal Care  
Brand: KOKUBO  
Description: Disposable body warmers that adhere to clothing for long‑lasting heat.

Title: 7" TFT LCD Monitor with Peaking, Zebra, False Color, HDMI Output  
Category: Electronics  
Brand: Lilliput

Title: Hatsune Miku Winter Live Kagamine Rin Action Figure

Brand: Taito

Title: 25 LED Santa Claus Brooches  
Category: Accessories

Title: 1.25" 5-Position Filter Wheel  
Category: Astronomy

Title: Spike 4.5" Vinyl Figure  
Category: Collectibles  
Brand: Titan Merchandise  
Description: A 4.5-inch tall vinyl figure of the vampire Spike from Buffy the Vampire Slayer.

Title: Educational Insights Jumbo Alphabet Transparent Stamps  
Category: Arts & Crafts  
Brand: Educational Insights

Title: Kastar Magic NP‑F980Exp 8700 mAh Lithium‑Ion Camera Battery
